"""Positive control of the R-AU2 structural test: one block, `tx` passed to the owner operation, no external effect."""
from codex_harness.host_os.adapters import process_groups


class Unit:
    def commit(self, task):
        with self.store.transaction() as tx:
            row = tx.get("tasks", task)
            self.ops.record(tx, row)
        process_groups.popen(["true"])  # outside the block: an external effect after the commit is allowed
        return row
